title: 第3章 松鹤真人第4章 驯兽庄
content_zh:
第3章松鹤真人
“哎，你不说我倒是想不起来，我腿也正麻着呢，赶快给师父我捶一捶。”松鹤得意的道。
青阳小道士没想到搬起石头，却砸了自己的脚，可师父有吩咐，不能不照做，他只好把碗放到一边，卷了卷袖子，正准备给师父捶腿。
忽然空中一阵鸟鸣声传来，青阳抬头一看，不知道从哪里飞来了一只漂亮的小红鸟。那小红鸟在空中一个盘旋，就落到了松鹤头顶的一根树枝上，随后翅膀一扇，落下了不少的灰尘。
师父松鹤正半躺在树下石头上，完全没有防备，就被那些灰尘迷了眼睛，他顿时气不打一处来，骂道：“哪里来的破鸟，真是该死。”
似乎觉得还不够解恨，他又随手脱下一只鞋子，就朝着那小红鸟扔了出去。松鹤的手法相当高明，尽管那小红鸟反应非常敏捷，还是被松鹤扔出的鞋子擦着了边，一根红色的羽毛飘然掉落。
那小红鸟似乎也怒了，伸着脖子叫了两声，然后在空中盘旋一圈，一团物事就朝着松鹤飞去。眼看着就要中招，松鹤再也不敢托大，连忙从树下的石头上站起身，闪到了一边。
师父松鹤刚刚闪开，那团物事就掉落在了他刚才躺过的石头上，只听啪的一声，一团青白相间的鸟屎就这么散开了。
松鹤后怕不已，自己若是躲得慢一点，这团鸟屎岂不是正好落在自己头上？就算是现在自己躲开了，可这块石头也被鸟屎给污染了，以后自己还怎么躺在这里喝酒？
想起这些，松鹤就怒不可遏，一只小鸟也敢这样欺负自己，真当江湖上鼎鼎有名的松鹤真人老了不成？
只见青阳师父松鹤右脚一顿，身体瞬间拔高一丈有余，就超过了刚才那小红鸟站立的树枝，然后他左脚飞快的伸出，在那树枝上轻轻一点，身体顺势前扑，转眼之间就到了那小红鸟的前面。
那小红鸟没有料到眼前这个老道士如此厉害，竟然也能像鸟儿一样飞到空中，他连忙展翅朝着另外一个方向飞去。
不过这时候已经晚了，不等小红鸟转身，师父松鹤的一只手已经伸了出来，直接捏住了他的一条腿。那小红鸟扑棱棱挣扎了几下，却是徒劳无功，始终无法挣脱松鹤的魔掌。
力道已经用尽，松鹤的身形开始降落，这时就见他腰部一拧，也不知是怎么用的力，师父松鹤下降的身体竟然硬生生的停住了，然后在空中来了一个旋转，就稳稳的落在了那歪脖树的树枝上。
青阳站在树下，满脸都是羡慕，不愧是师父，这一身轻功果然厉害，别看自己已经跟着师父学了近十年，却连他一成的功力都没有学到，同样都是上树，自己就只能手脚并用往上爬。
师父松鹤站在粗大的树枝上，看着手中那只小红鸟，自语道：“敢欺负道爷我，真是活腻歪了，看我不捏死你！”
话音刚落，就听一个清丽的声音道：“住手，放开我的小鸟。”
师父松鹤对此似乎早有预料，微微笑了笑，冲着那声音的方向道：“哪里来的小辈，竟敢戏弄我江湖中鼎鼎有名的松鹤真人，真是吃了雄心豹子胆，还不速速出来领罪？”
那清丽的声音却丝毫不怕，冷哼了一声，道：“老家伙，是你先打伤了我的小红，还让我出去赔罪？这绝不可能。”
松鹤道：“那就别怪我不客气了，这小鸟看着不大，身子倒是挺肥的，身上的肉应该不少。道爷我好久没有开过荤了，不如留着晚上打打牙祭。是红烧？还是清炖？又或者是直接烤了吃？”

听到松鹤的话，那清丽的声音似乎也急了，道：“你敢？”
“那你就看看道爷我敢不敢！”说着手上似乎就要用力。
就在这时，旁边的树干上忽然之间就窜出了一条小黑蛇，朝着松鹤的脚踝就咬了过去。师父松鹤纵横江湖数十年，天不怕地不怕，就怕这种瘆人的毒蛇，看到小黑蛇突然出现，他腿一软，就从树上掉了下来，不过也算是歪打正着，正好躲过了那小黑蛇的攻击。
一击不中，那小黑蛇却仍不罢休，绕着树干游走了一圈，然后身子一抖，竟然直接从空中朝着松鹤窜去。
那树枝离地也就一丈多高，哪怕松鹤是从树上跌落的，以师父的身手倒也伤不到什么，只是落地的姿态极其狼狈。松鹤落地之后，胆子稍微大了一些，至少腿已经不软了，不过他仍不敢直接面对那小黑蛇，于是身形一闪，就躲到了徒弟青阳的身后。
青阳当然是跟自己师父一伙的，看那小黑蛇得理不饶人，甚至连自己都要攻击，他顿时就做好了准备，也不知从怀中掏出了什么，随手就撒了出去，一道黄色的迷雾瞬间出现在身前。
这黄色的迷雾正是驱蛇用的雄黄粉，松鹤与青阳经常行走江湖，这些都是必备之物，只不过刚才小黑蛇出现的太过突然，松鹤又天生害怕蛇类，这才没有反应过来。
那小黑蛇被雄黄粉一逼，顿时就不敢再往前追击，不过他也没有退缩，就盘在青阳面前不远的地方，吐着信子幽幽的盯着前面。
有了青阳的缓冲，松鹤总算是缓过了那一口气，不过想到自己竟然被一条蛇吓得从树上跌落下来，而且被一个后生小辈逼得手忙脚乱，几十年了还没有这么狼狈过，他顿时就怒不可遏，手中暗自扣着一枚石子，喝道：“姓皮的，你要是再不出来管管，道爷我可就不客气了，到时候你别怪我以大欺小。”
师父也就是天生怕蛇，刚才又没有防备，才会被吓了一跳，如今缓过劲来，对付一条小黑蛇自然是容易之极，不说别的，就是手中的那枚石子就能把小黑蛇钉死在地上。
“松鹤真人，手下留情啊！”松鹤话音刚落，一道洪亮的声音就从远处传来，与此同时，一条高大的身影从山下飞奔而来。
这条身影高大之极，比普通人至少要高出一头，身材壮硕，肌肉发达，毛发浓密，就连皮肤都黝黑发亮，猛的看上去就犹如一头黑熊成精一般，跑起路来更是感觉整个山头都在颤动。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 3 Songhe Zhenren
"Hey, I wouldn't have remembered it if you didn't tell me. My legs are numb too. Give me a quick slap, Master." Song He said proudly.
The little Taoist priest Qingyang didn't expect that he would hit his own foot by lifting the rock, but he had to obey the master's instructions. He had no choice but to put the bowl aside, rolled up his sleeves, and was about to beat his master's legs.
Suddenly there was a sound of birdsong in the air. Qingyang looked up and saw a beautiful little red bird flying from nowhere. The little red bird circled in the air and landed on a branch above Songhe's head. Then it flapped its wings and dropped a lot of dust.
Master Songhe was half lying on the stone under the tree, completely defenseless, and his eyes were blinded by the dust. He suddenly became angry and cursed: "Where did this broken bird come from? You really deserve to die."
As if he thought it wasn't enough to satisfy his hatred, he took off another shoe and threw it towards the little red bird. Songhe's technique was quite clever. Even though the little red bird reacted very quickly, it was still scratched by the shoe thrown by Songhe, and a red feather fell floating down.
The little red bird seemed to be angry. It stretched out its neck and called twice, then circled in the air and flew towards Songhe. Seeing that he was about to be hit, Songhe no longer dared to stand up, and quickly stood up from the stone under the tree and stepped aside.
As soon as Master Songhe got out of the way, the object fell on the stone where he had just been lying. With a snap, a ball of green and white bird droppings scattered.
Song Hehou was terrified. If he had hid slower, wouldn't this ball of bird poop just fall on his head? Even if I avoid it now, this stone is still contaminated by bird droppings. How can I still lie here and drink in the future?
Thinking of these, Songhe became furious. A little bird dared to bully him like this. Did he really think that Songhe, a famous person in the world, was old?
I saw Qingyang Master Songhe's right foot pause, and his body instantly rose more than a foot higher, surpassing the branch where the little red bird was standing just now. Then he quickly stretched out his left foot, tapped lightly on the branch, and rushed forward with his body. In the blink of an eye, he was in front of the little red bird.
The little red bird didn't expect that the old Taoist priest in front of him was so powerful that he could fly into the air like a bird. He quickly spread his wings and flew in the other direction.
But it was too late by this time. Before the little red bird could turn around, one of master Songhe's hands had already stretched out and pinched one of his legs. The little red bird fluttered and struggled a few times, but it was in vain and could not break free from Song He's clutches.
Having exhausted all his strength, Songhe's figure began to fall. At this moment, he twisted his waist, and no one knew how hard he used it. Master Songhe's descending body stopped abruptly, then spun in the air, and landed firmly on the branch of the crooked neck tree.
Qingyang stood under the tree, his face full of envy. He was indeed his master. This light kung fu was indeed amazing. Even though he had been studying with his master for nearly ten years, he didn't even learn 10% of his skills. He also climbed up the tree, so he could only use his hands and feet to climb up.
Master Songhe stood on a thick branch, looked at the little red bird in his hand, and said to himself: "You dare to bully me, Master Tao, you are so tired of living, let's see if I don't crush you to death!"
As soon as I finished speaking, I heard a clear voice saying: "Stop, let go of my little bird."
Master Songhe seemed to have expected this. He smiled slightly and said in the direction of the voice: "Where did this junior dare to tease Songhe, who is famous in the world? He really took the courage of an ambitious leopard, why don't you come out and take the blame quickly?"
The clear voice was not afraid at all. She snorted coldly and said, "Old guy, you hurt my Xiaohong first and then asked me to go out and apologize? This is absolutely impossible."
Songhe said: "Then don't blame me for being rude. This little bird doesn't look big, but its body is quite fat.There should be a lot of meat on the body. Master Tao, I haven't had meat for a long time, so why not save it for the evening meal? Is it braised? Or stew? Or maybe just bake it and eat it? "
Hearing Songhe's words, the clear voice seemed to be anxious, saying: "You dare? "
"Then let's see if I dare, Master Dao! "As he spoke, his hands seemed to be using force.
At this moment, a small black snake suddenly sprang out from the tree trunk next to it and bit Songhe's ankle. Master Songhe has been traveling around the world for decades, and he is not afraid of anything but this terrifying poisonous snake. When he saw the little black snake suddenly appeared, his legs weakened and he fell from the tree. However, he managed to escape the attack of the little black snake.
Even though the attack missed, the little black snake didn't give up. It swam around the tree trunk, then with a shake of its body, it flew directly towards Songhe from the air.
The branch was only more than ten feet high from the ground. Even if Songhe fell from the tree, the master's skill would not cause any harm, but he would fall to the ground in an extremely awkward posture. After Songhe landed, he became a little bolder, at least his legs were no longer weak, but he still didn't dare to face the little black snake directly, so he hid behind his apprentice Qingyang in a flash.
Of course Qingyang was with his master. Seeing that the little black snake was unforgiving and even wanted to attack himself, he was immediately prepared. He took out something from his arms and threw it out casually, and a yellow mist instantly appeared in front of him.
This yellow mist is the realgar powder used to repel snakes. Songhe and Qingyang often travel in rivers and lakes. These are necessary things. However, the little black snake appeared too suddenly just now, and Songhe is naturally afraid of snakes, so he did not react.
The little black snake was forced by the realgar powder and immediately did not dare to pursue him any further. However, he did not flinch. He coiled himself not far in front of Qingyang, spitting out his words and staring faintly in front of him.
With Qingyang's buffer, Songhe finally breathed a sigh of relief, but when he thought that he was frightened by a snake and fell out of the tree, and was forced into a panic by a junior, he had not been in such a mess for decades, he immediately became furious, secretly holding a stone in his hand, and shouted: "Pi, if you don't come out to take care of me, I won't be polite. Don't blame me for bullying the small." "
The master is naturally afraid of snakes, and he was unprepared just now, so he was startled. Now that he has calmed down, it is naturally extremely easy to deal with a little black snake. If nothing else, just the stone in his hand can nail the little black snake to the ground.
"Master Songhe, please be merciful! "As soon as Song He finished speaking, a loud voice came from a distance, and at the same time, a tall figure flew from the bottom of the mountain.
This figure was extremely tall, at least a head taller than an ordinary person. It had a strong build, well-developed muscles, and thick hair. Even its skin was dark and shiny. It looked so fierce that it looked like a black bear that had become a spirit. When it ran, it felt like the entire mountain was shaking.
(End of chapter)
